mapper.sql: id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, payload, status, retry_count, last_error, next_retry_at, created_at, published_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_events ( aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, payload, status ) VALUES ( #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, #{payload}, 'PENDING' )
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_events SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = NOW(), last_error = NULL, next_retry_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE outbox_events SET status = 'FAILED', retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_error = #{lastError}, next_retry_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE outbox_events SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_error = #{lastError}, next_retry_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{retryDelaySeconds} SECOND) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM outbox_events WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= NOW()) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT #{limit}
